description: Queue a street-view image download job for a list of PanoIDs. Images are written as JPEG under outputDir by the controller/workers. Returns a jobId; monitor with panoon_job_status. Confirm outputDir and scope with the user before large jobs.

outputDir.description: Absolute output directory for the JPEG files.

serverUrl.description: Distributed controller URL. Default: the local service.

name: panoon_download
